title: Correct clock
subtitle: The car's computer knows the real date and time.
description: The car's computer thinks it is 1970 every time it starts, even though it has a working clock inside. This app sets the right date and time at start-up. Secure internet connections and correct file dates need it. It also fixes a stock bug that shows up once the clock is right: time and time-zone changes in Settings were being lost.
